name: Metamagic Rod, Ectoplasmic
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser ectoplasmic metamagic rod 3,000 gp
Ectoplasmic metamagic rod 11,000 gp
Greater ectoplasmic metamagic rod 24,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that have full effect against incorporeal creatures, as though she were using the Ectoplasmic Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Ectoplasmic Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser ectoplasmic metamagic rod 1,500 gp
Ectoplasmic metamagic rod 5,500 gp
Greater ectoplasmic metamagic rod 12,250 gp
